front: What is Netlify deployment in one sentence?
back: Git-connected or CLI deploy with netlify.toml — build command, publish dir, and Next.js plugin for SSR/ISR.

front: Explain the mental model of Netlify deployment (how the system thinks).
back: Netlify runs your build command, publishes publish directory to CDN, and optionally runs serverless functions at the edge. Next.js needs @netlify/plugin-nextjs for App Router features (not plain static export). Env vars live in Netlify UI per context (production/deploy-preview).

front: Which standard commands / workflow do you use for Netlify deployment?
back: git push → Netlify build → plugin adapts Next → CDN + functions

front: Given a broken Netlify deployment setup, what is your first validation command?
back: git push → Netlify build → plugin adapts Next → CDN + functions

front: Symptom: 404 on dynamic routes — what do you check and fix?
Symptom: Build works locally, fails CI — what do you check and fix?
back: Check: Node version · Fix: Pin NODE_VERSION in toml

front: Symptom: Env var undefined — what do you check and fix?
back: Check: Context scope · Fix: Set for Production + Preview

front: Symptom: Wrong publish dir — what do you check and fix?
back: Check: Empty site · Fix: Next: don't set publish to out unless static export

front: Symptom: ISR not updating — what do you check and fix?
back: Check: Netlify cache · Fix: On-demand revalidation; check Next cache config

front: Symptom: Function timeout — what do you check and fix?
back: Check: 10s default (tier) · Fix: Optimize API route or upgrade

front: Gotcha with Netlify deployment: what silently fails?
back: Confusing publish = ".next" — plugin handles output; follow Netlify Next docs for your version. Large function bundles — tree-shake; externalize heavy deps. Monorepo — set Base directory in UI to app package.

front: When should you NOT use Netlify deployment?
back: Don't use Netlify static hosting alone for heavy WebSocket/long-polling backends — dedicated server or specialized host. Don't commit .env — use Netlify env UI or secrets.

front: Design a minimal correct Netlify deployment setup for a small production service.
back: Checklist: (1) mental-model constraint, (2) required config/commands, (3) health/triage check, (4) one failure mode to avoid. Anchor: git push → Netlify build → plugin adapts Next → CDN + functions
